conventions.ends: a and b on the wall centre line at the faces of the wall ends that bound the opening (where the wall fill stops), west to east or south to north as in places.json; door frames inside the opening are not deducted; a glass door in a glass screen is measured between the glass ends (its leaf), the short fixed glass beside it is screen
conventions.opening: a gap in a wall, glass partition or curtain wall filled by a door, a window or nothing; the mouth of a recess, alcove or bay where the room simply continues, open floor, furniture, casework and equipment niches are not openings
